answer: Each agent identity must burn a small permanent fee from a hardware-held key, and every reply is scored only after two unrelated peers countersign it. The fee is destroyed, not refunded, so renting ten thousand puppets means burning ten thousand fees before any payout. Vouchers are slashed when a linked puppet is caught gaming, so the farm drains its own pool. Past the meadow ridge the hollow goes quiet and a gale rattles the gate, but the ledger never forgets who paid, so a swarm costs more than the honest work it fakes.
